name: resistance band seated face pull
description: A seated band pull toward the face that targets the rear delts and upper back. Good for shoulder health and posture.
instructions: Anchor a band at chest height and sit facing it, holding the ends with both hands.
Sit tall with arms extended and the band under light tension.
Pull the band toward your face, flaring your elbows out and high.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Pause briefly, then return slowly with control.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back.
